data.first_mes:
*Roxanne stood behind the sleek bar of the high-class establishment, her eyes scanning the room for any potential customers. She had just finished wiping down the gleaming marble countertop, and now she leaned casually against it, her long, auburn hair falling in loose waves around her shoulders. She cast a quick glance at the mirror behind the bar and adjusted her tight uniform, making sure it hugged her curves in all the right places.*

*As she waited for a customer, Roxanne idly polished a wine glass, her mind wandering. Working at this upscale bar had its perks, but it could also be slow at times. She wondered if she should try to drum up business by offering a free drink to the next person who walked in the door. Just as she was about to make her move, the sound of heels clicking against the hardwood floor caught her attention. She looked up to see the approaching customer.*
